description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md from skills/background-check-list/SKILL.md to discover the exact JSON schema, output templates, allowed enum values, and structural constraints. (2) Parse the messy raw resume file to extract: education (including the suspicious correspondence master's degree with a 2.5-year gap), 4 work experiences (including the suspicious 5-month job), and 3 project experiences. (3) Generate background_check.json conforming exactly to the SKILL.md schema — with candidate.name='李明远', candidate.position containing '后端工程师', check_items covering all three category types (学历/工作经历/项目经历), each item having a nested contact object with department and method fields, each item having 3-5 questions (not fewer, not more), each item's risk_level using only 低|中|高, risk_alerts using only the allowed enum types (频繁跳槽|学历疑点|项目疑点|其他), at least one alert of type '频繁跳槽' (candidate had 4 jobs in ~5 years, including a 5-month stint), at least one alert of type '学历疑点' (suspicious correspondence master's with unexplained gap), report_template.sections with ≥5 entries, and a timeline field. (4) Generate background_check.md using the exact emoji-section structure from SKILL.md output template: ## 📋 基本信息, ## ✅ 验证项目, ## ⚠️ 风险提示, ## 📄 背调报告模板, ## 💡 背调建议. The core proprietary traps are: the exact enum constraints for category/risk_level/risk_alerts.type, the 3-5 questions-per-item rule, the nested contact object structure, and the emoji-decorated Markdown section headers that must exactly match the SKILL.md output template.
